achievements: Planned project-based courses covering HTML5, CSS3, modern JavaScript, and basic data structures.

name: Chiko AI
description: Building Chiko AI, a Chrome extension and web app that reads a webpage and returns key points, possible biases, open questions, and citations that link to the exact source sentence. I write the extension, the website and dashboard, and the backend.
achievements: Built the Manifest V3 Chrome extension: a side panel, on-demand page extraction, and click-to-highlight citations.
Built a research workspace where users group saved pages into projects and ask questions across them.
Moved bring-your-own API keys out of the browser. They are now stored encrypted on the server only.
Set up the waitlist on its own subdomain and wrote the privacy policy and the Chrome Web Store permission justifications.

name: Skooland
description: Building Skooland, a school operating system where each school gets its own website and separate portals for students, staff, parents, and management. I write the frontend, the backend, and the database layer.
achievements: Designed multi-tenant storage where each school has its own PostgreSQL schema, so one school's data never mixes with another's.
Built subdomain routing so each school and each portal gets its own address, like management.school.skooland.com.
Built the school admin console: portal access codes, a block-based website editor, termly billing, and add-on licensing.
Wrote a sync API so schools running the Queez CBT offline exam server can pull students and exam papers and push results back. It uses scoped API keys that schools can rotate.
